text:
I had a very unpleasant experience at U Smile Dental Clinic.  I was treated rudely and I will never return.  I would advise people to stay away from this place.  There are many other dental clinics in Bangkok.
I had visited U Smile Dental Clinic 2 years ago for a dental cleaning and scaling.  My experience at that time had been very positive.   The dentist who treated me was competent, caring and polite.  I returned for another treatment last Wednesday and was treated by another dentist.  My experience this time was totally different.  I came into the treatment room and was totally ignored by the dentist who did not even greet me.  Her assistant told me to sit on the treatment chair.  Without a word, the dentist started cleaning my teeth in a speedy and seemingly careless manner.  The cleaning lasted for around 10 to 15 minutes.  The dentist at times sang to herself.  At the end, the fluoride polishing was done without any fluoride on the brush.  The whole process was rushed and seemed to be done carelessly.  I left saying goodbye.  The dentist did not bother responding.  I totally felt as a non person.  I had recommended your clinic to a few friends of mine.  I will now tell them to expect rudeness and careless service.  I should add that I drove one full hour from the other side of Bangkok in order to return to your clinic.  You might be bored with your own life, but keep in mind that your patients are actual human beings...  Respect yourself...  how can you treat others with courtesy when you do not have any dignity or self respect...
